text_block_list.text: One day, while visiting a bookstore――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer I see around a lot! Howdy~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Could it be, you came for the talk show 
too?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
By the big-shot Space Western author! It 
got adapted into a movie and is super 
famous, you know!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."INTE". Another-verse theory... is 
'thrilling', isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Want to join in with us? 
Walk-ins are welcome too!

Since I was already there, I attended the 
talk show. The discussion was full of 
depth――
choice_data_list: That was really interesting, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative...! I felt the "accelerated 
expansion"... of 'knowledge'.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo! There was even a surprise 
announcement for a new movie! The 
excitement won't stop!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Next, we will hold the autograph session. 
Those who wish to participate, please line 
up.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Universe! Since we're here, let's get an 
autograph!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's your chance to discuss the theories 
you're curious about!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...That proposal... 'requires 
deliberation'...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A "trial" before... But the "response" 
was... "void"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This time, too... might be "unreachable 
signal"...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Don't worry! Communication is all 
about passion!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
As long as you don't lose the desire to 
convey your thoughts, it'll definitely get 
through!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So let's give it a try!! Even if you crash 
into a wall, I'll pick up your bones!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
... Taiki Shuttle's 'recommendation' is... 
"BALS"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
However... "Q". Neo Universe... may have 
received "thrust"...

text_block_list.name: SF Author
text_block_list.text:
Next in line, please step forward. ――Oh, 
you're...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Universe! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Are you 'remembering'... Neo 
Universe...?

text_block_list.name: SF Author
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I remember you very well! Sorry I 
wasn't able to react properly last time.

text_block_list.name: SF Author
text_block_list.text:
I analyzed what you told me afterward... 
You shared your own perspective on my 
theory, didn't you? Would you tell me more 
about it in detail?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――! Spheres...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Universe, your conversation was really 
lively! That's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A 'fulfilling'... "CMIN", thanks to Taiki 
Shuttle's "thrust"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe... says 'thank you'...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! Seeing Universe smile 
makes I'm happy!
choice_data_list:
I'd love to learn from that positive 
attitude
You really care about your friends

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! Seeing Universe smile 
makes I'm happy!
choice_data_list:
I'd love to learn from that positive 
attitude
You really care about your friends

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Taiki Shuttle's "thought 
principle"... is a "quasar."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I don't really get it, but I'm 
blushing anyway!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YES! Tracen Academy is my second home, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My friends ARE my family!! Everyone's 
smile is my happiness!!

As she laughed and said that, Taiki 
Shuttle looked truly dazzling.
